adjudication.rationale:
In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists:
```ts
destinationCalendar: eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null,
```
Then for COLLECTIVE team event types, teammate calendars are appended via optional chaining:
```ts
if (isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE") {
  evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);
}
```
If `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, the `push` no-ops and all collected `teamDestinationCalendars` are dropped. Downstream, `createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it falls back to creating events via default credentials, so the teammates’ destination calendars won’t be used in this edge case. This is a real behavioral defect exposed by the diff.
